text:
Rae (DevRel): throwing out a nimble plan: "MicroLaunch" — 2 bite tutorials, 1 compact ref-app, short benchmark note, 30-min live workshop. target: dev signups + repo signals. who owns what?
Tom (Growth): +1. KPIs: RSVP -> attend rate, repo forks, trial starts. need UTMs and segments.
Mina (Content): I can draft the launch post, two tutorial drafts, and a tiny FAQ. will want 3 GIF steps per tutorial.
Garrett (PMM): benchmark narrative: one hero stat, method blurb, and a reproducible command. focus on cost/latency delta with Optimize preset vs baseline. keep it small.
Sofia (Design): I can do the hero + three step cards. need final art 48h before publish.
ops-bot: uploaded assets to drive.redwood.ai/microlaunch/assets (starter-repo, slides, art)
Rae (DevRel): funnel sketch: blog -> tutorial A -> tutorial B -> workshop sign-up -> post-workshop bench email. routing: tag leads `microlaunch_*` and route high-engagers to SE trial queue.
Tom (Growth): segmentation draft: clicked_tutorial, registered, attended, forked_repo. UTMs: `?utm_source=microlaunch&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=micro-labs`
Mina (Content): social draft: "MicroLaunch: 2 tiny tutorials to ship an LLM microfeature in 30 mins. RSVP for the hands-on lab." email subject: "Ship an LLM microfeature in 30 minutes — MicroLaunch"
Garrett (PMM): bench command draft: `./bench.py --model redwood-lite --seq 256 --batch 8 --optimize preset_a --cache prefix` We'll publish raw logs in the repo. Hero stat candidate: "~38% lower per-token cost with Optimize preset A (latency ~par)."
Sofia (Design): thumbnails: 1200x1200 square + 16:9 hero. I'll push two colorways to drive.
Rae (DevRel): owners: Mina = content + blog, Garrett = bench + numbers, Sofia = design, Tom = distribution + routing, Rae = webinar ops + repo maintainer. agreed?
All: :+1:
Mina (Content): timeline suggestion: Day0 announce + tutorial A; Day3 tutorial B + RSVP push; Day6 webinar + bench summary + follow-up nurture. compress if needed.
Tom (Growth): compression OK if bench becomes appendix. I'll set up form and analytics, wire UTMs, and add hidden `microlaunch` field.
Rae (DevRel): CTA copy for signup: "Join MicroLaunch: a 30-min workshop to build, benchmark, and ship a micro LLM feature." form fields: name, company, email, role, interest.
ops-bot: opened PR: github.com/redwood-inference/microlaunch/pull/3 (tutorial A + assets)
Garrett (PMM): will prepare 2-slide "how we measured" for the webinar and a tiny repo appendix with the exact machine spec + raw logs.
Mina (Content): checklist I'll use: quickstart README, 3 gifs, sample inputs, bench logs, slides, CTAs (star repo, start trial). PR by tomorrow morning.
Sofia (Design): note: social GIFs should be mobile-first. I'll supply 1x and 2x assets.
Tom (Growth): routing rules: attendees -> tag:micro_attended; forks -> tag:micro_forked; high-engagement (attend+fork) -> SEops queue. send webhook with `source=microlaunch`.
Rae (DevRel): small ops ask: include `source=microlaunch` in all internal payloads and surface tags in SEops webhook.
ops-bot: scheduled reminder: 24h before publish to #marketing
Mina (Content): need hero-stat signoff from Garrett before scheduling.
Garrett (PMM): signed: hero stat provisional until bench run is uploaded. will push bench logs to repo by EOD.
Rae (DevRel): final: everyone add ETA to PR, flag blockers. aim for low-friction, dev-first content to surface strong trial signals. :rocket:
